metaDescription: Convert schema.org microdata in pasted HTML to JSON-LD. Nested itemscope becomes nested objects and itemref is followed. Runs locally.
intro: Reads itemscope, itemtype, itemprop and itemid from pasted HTML and writes equivalent JSON-LD.
why:
Moving from microdata to JSON-LD means rewriting markup by hand, and mistakes creep in with nested items. This tool applies the value rules of the HTML Microdata specification: meta content, src and href for links, data and time attributes, text content otherwise, and follows itemref.

Values keep their string form, so a price stays "89.99"; the converter does not guess numbers. Relative links stay relative unless you give a base URL.
howTo: Paste the HTML with the microdata.
Optionally enter the base URL for relative links.
Place it in a script tag and remove the microdata attributes.

faq.a: Yes. An element with itemscope and itemprop becomes a nested object.

faq.q: What about several items on a page?
faq.a: Several top-level items are output in one @graph.

faq.q: Is the output verified against another converter?
faq.a: Checked by hand against the specification on samples; no independent converter was available in the build environment.
